text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: embed-service high 5xx rate detected (avg 18% over 2m). Escalation to eng-oncall.

devon: oncall here. seeing an uptick in 503/504s on the embed endpoint. traffic spike from batch job?

cheng: looking at host metrics now. memory pressure on GPU pods and some OOMKiller events. kv-cache miss rate went up 3x.

maria: customer impact: 3 customers reported timeouts, dashboard shows a small spike in retries leading to client errors. product-oncall pinged support.

devon: immediate mitigation: enable dedicated fallback pool for embed route, reduce max-concurrency to 6, and toggle prefix-KV cache to read-only to avoid thrashing. I'll flip flags.

alex: :thumbsup: list of commands I'm running to change routing:
```bash
# flip traffic to dedicated_fallback
curl -X POST https://api.internal/route/switch -d '{"route":"/embed","target":"dedicated_fallback"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# set max concurrency
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/embed-svc MAX_CONCURRENCY=6
```

cheng: confirmed: GPU pod mem climbed to 95% then some restarted. I triggered a rolling restart on the suspect node pool to clear leaked handles. Watching KV cache metrics.

devon: update: dedicated fallback absorbing 60% of traffic, latency stable for routed requests. Overall 5xx down to 6% from 18%. Good progress but don't declare done.

product-oncall: support updated customers: temporary mitigation in place, we're waiting on full stability before wider comms.

maria: suggested next steps for post-incident follow-up: runbook gaps, add an automated circuit-breaker for embed route, and a test that simulates high prefix-miss churn. I'll own running the follow-up doc.

alex: I'll add a small reproducer to the integration tests and a Jenkins job to run it nightly. Assigning to myself.

devon: cheng can you capture the heap/memory traces and attach heap dump to the ticket? we might have a stray leak in the runtime.

cheng: got it. I'll upload dumps to the incident ticket and link here.

sre-rotation: logging a short-term config change: increased node eviction threshold from 80% -> 90% to reduce noisy restarts while we root cause. Will revert once we have fixes.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Pager resolved. Last error rate sample 1.2% over 5m. Auto-attach: incident/1763000245.

devon: blameless note: this looks like a combination of miss-heavy workload + cache eviction edge causing mem spikes. No perf regression in model.

maria: scheduling: propose a post-incident writeup and a 45-min "learn-and-prevent" session next Tues 11AM. Topics: runbook updates, circuit-breaker design, KV cache visibility.

alex: putting a calendar invite on eng-all, will include a small demo of the reproducer.

cheng: action items I'm taking: (1) heap dump analysis + write up (2) add alert for prefix-miss churn > 2x baseline.

maria: my action items: (1) create post-incident doc in /ops/incidents/1763000245 (2) update runbook steps for embed surge (add explicit fallback checklist) (3) coordinate brown-bag.

devon: I'll own the code change to the autoscaler config (safer thresholds) and a canary rollout plan.

product-oncall: I'll draft a customer-facing note template; wait until postmortem is done before sending.

maria: quick checklist for the post-incident doc: timeline, root-cause hypothesis, mitigation steps, action owners, rollback plan, and follow-up verification criteria.

alex: putting tasks into tracker: INS-1763000245-1 (reproducer), -2 (autoscaler change), -3 (runbook update), -4 (alerts).

devon: can we add an ops playbook snippet to the runbook with the exact commands I ran? saves time on next page.

cheng: yes, will add commands + helpful grafana queries.

maria: training shareout plan: 30m of walkthrough + 15m Q/A. We'll record it for asynchronous teams. who wants to present?

devon: happy to present the mitigation timeline and lessons. alex can demo the reproducer. cheng can cover heap/mem findings.

product-oncall: +1 on recording. I'll set the invite to be hybrid.

devon: final note: thanks all for quick responses. no customer data exposure. keep actions tracked; we'll review in next ops sync. :sparkles:

sre-rotation: closing loop: created the incident ticket and linked PRs. Tagging follow-ups for next oncall handover. :spiral_calendar:

maria: thanks team — moving to the writeup now and will ping when doc is ready for review. :memo:
